title: List installed systemd unit files and their states
summary: Show all systemd unit files installed on your system and whether they are enabled, disabled, or static. This helps you see what services and timers are configured to start automatically.

steps.explain: List all installed unit files and their enablement states (enabled, disabled, static, etc.).
steps.expect: A table listing unit file names and their states.

steps.explain: If the output is long and stuck in a pager, use --no-pager to print it directly to the terminal.
steps.expect: The full list printed without interactive paging.
